_comment: One canonical name per remediation. The 15 hand-curated errors and the rule-labelled catalog grew separate vocabularies for identical concepts (unlock_account vs enable_or_unlock_account, rotate_app_secret vs rotate_client_secret). Two names for one action meant the classifier could not predict curated codes at all -- the correct label was absent from its label space -- and every alias needed its own translation string. This maps the duplicates onto a single canonical set, applied in model/build_catalog.py.
